summary: Tested Retailer Payment and Invoicing Upgrade with Credit Notes and Upfront Collection %. All backend APIs and frontend UI components are working correctly. Credit Notes tab displays list with summary cards, Invoice Payment Modal shows Available Credit Notes section when pending credits exist, and credit note selection with checkbox and amount input works correctly.
passed_tests: 2. GET /api/retailer-credit-notes/pending/{retailer_id} - Returns pending credit notes with count and total_pending_credit
3. GET /api/retailer-credit-notes - Lists all credit notes with filtering by retailer_id and status
4. GET /api/retailer-credit-notes/summary/{retailer_id} - Returns credit summary (total_issued, total_adjusted, total_pending)
5. POST /api/retailer-credit-notes - Creates credit note from rejection with auto-generated CN number
6. POST /api/retailer-invoices/{invoice_id}/payment - Payment with credit_adjustments parameter works correctly
7. Credit note status changes from 'pending' to 'partial' or 'adjusted' after payment
8. Credit Notes tab in Retailer Orders page - Displays list with summary cards (Total Credit Issued, Pending Credit, Adjusted, Total Notes)
9. Credit Notes table shows: CN #, Retailer, Original Invoice, Amount, Adjusted, Pending, Status, Created
10. Invoice Payment Modal - Shows 'Available Credit Notes' section when pending credits exist for retailer
11. Credit Note selection - Checkbox and amount input work correctly in payment modal
12. Credit note CN-0001 for Tamanna Mart visible with ₹15 pending (₹15 already used)
13. DELETE /api/retailer-credit-notes/{credit_note_id} - Deletes pending credit notes (cleanup test passed)
critical_code_review_comments: RetailerCreditNote model (models.py lines 801-843) correctly defines all required fields including status, adjusted_amount, pending_amount, and adjusted_against_invoices
Credit note routes (server.py lines 11144-11376) properly implement CRUD operations with proper validation
Payment with credit adjustments (server.py lines 11764-11904) correctly updates both invoice and credit note records
Frontend Credit Notes tab (RetailerOrders.js lines 129-137) properly manages state for credit notes
loadPendingCreditNotesForPayment function (lines 497-512) correctly fetches pending credits for payment modal
Payment modal credit notes section (lines 10454-10556) properly displays checkboxes and amount inputs for credit selection
seed_data_creation: Used existing credit note CN-0001 for Tamanna Mart (₹30 total, ₹15 pending, ₹15 adjusted)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credit Notes feature fully tested and working. The system supports: 1) Creating credit notes from rejections against old invoices, 2) Displaying pending credit notes in payment modal, 3) Applying credit adjustments during invoice payment, 4) Tracking credit note status (pending/partial/adjusted). Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_credit_notes.py can be reused for regression testing.
